item.title: Programming
item.description:
Tricking rocks into thinking using magic words

By trade I am programmer working in the audio industry. Outside of my day job, I enjoy making games and hacking together small software toys.

Languages and frameworks

  • C++
    • Making realtime audio tools using JUCE
    • Making games using SDL and Raylib
  • C#
    • Suffering Scripting game objects using Unity 3D
    • Making games in MonoGame
  • Python

This list isn’t exhaustive, so its probably best to look at my GitHub or get in touch if you want to discuss stuff in specific.
